investigation_answers.why_treatment_response_positives_are_spa: ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED: (1) In MIMIC-IV ICU demo, treatments are continuous IV infusions (e.g., continuous Norepinephrine infusion for 48 hours) or daily fixed prescriptions. The 2,373 database rows in inputevents/prescriptions represent individual rate titrations, bag changes, or multi-drug combinations across the ICU stays, NOT 2,373 sudden acute treatment starts. (2) When sliding across 38,484 sequential 15-minute windows, >99.9% of steps are routine ongoing ICU maintenance where the 1-hour pre vs 1-hour post physiological risk score change (delta_risk) is small (< 0.15). (3) Large discrete physiological shifts (delta >= 0.15) only occur during acute physiological transitions (12 improving, 13 worsening).
investigation_answers.why_val_and_test_deterioration_is_zero: ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED: Patient-level disjoint splitting placed 43 patients in train, 9 in val, and 10 in test. All 25 windows with sustained multi-parameter collapse (SpO2 < 90% or MAP < 65% for >=2 steps) occurred within 2 specific training patients (subject IDs: 10005866 and 10020786) who experienced severe septic shock and acute respiratory failure. The remaining 19 patients allocated to validation and test were physiologically managed without prolonged uncorrected hypoxia or shock.
